Description
Bullion Trading LLC presents the best opportunity to invest in physical gold at a lower premium with our 1 oz Gold Bar with assay card  and get a sense of financial stability.
The 1 oz Gold Bar – (IGR) Istanbul Gold Refinery (New with Assay) we carry is of .9999 fine gold. We provide each bar in original assay card packaging. The bars are sealed in protective assay packaging to protect them from tampering and validate the authenticity of the gold.
Design of 1
oz
Gold Bar – (IGR) Istanbul Gold Refinery (New with Assay)
The reverse side of all Istanbul Gold Refinery gold bars features the “IGR” initials. These letters are set on a 45-degree angle with a repeating pattern that continues across the reverse face of the bar. As you look at your assay card packaging, you’ll find the company logo, metal content, and weight on the obverse. The reverse of the assay card has the purity of the metal and the weight also listed. An assayer’s signature is featured on this side, along with two UV-light security features not visible to the naked eye. A hologram at the bottom of the assay also provides a layer of anti-counterfeiting security.
Main Highlights of 1
oz
Gold Bar – (IGR) Istanbul Gold Refinery (New with Assay)
1 oz gold bar  of .9999 pure gold
Each gold bar is delivered in protective assay packaging
Reverse side of all Istanbul Gold Refinery gold bars features the “IGR” initials.
On the obverse side  you will see The bar’s weight, metal content, serial number and purity are engraved vertically in the center of the bar’s design field.
